description: This file implements the SharedMemoryBuffer class, which manages shared memory segments for media playback data, including creation, mapping, unmapping, clearing, and data access functions. It also includes factory methods for creating instances and utility functions for handling different media types.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Manages shared memory segments for media data, including creation, mapping, unmapping, clearing, and data access.

methods.name: calculatePartitionSize
methods.description: Calculates partition sizes based on media playback type and number of partitions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaPlaybackType enum to string representation.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory instance for SharedMemoryBuffer objects.

methods.name: createSharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a SharedMemoryBuffer instance with specified number of playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shared memory segments and partitions.

methods.name: ~SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up shared memory resources.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Maps a partition for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Unmaps a partition for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears data in a specified partition for a given media source type.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of data for a given playback type, ID, and media source type.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Returns the maximum data length for a given playback type, ID, and media source type.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for a given playback type, ID, and media source type.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the shared memory segment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: calculateBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates total buffer size based on partitions.

methods.name: getDataPtrForPartition
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the data for a specific partition.

methods.name: getPlaybackTypePartition
methods.description: Returns the vector of partitions for a given playback type.

calls: mmap(nullptr, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0)
